blurb: WELCOME to Mammoth Lakes Pack Outfit. We are a full service pack station located in the Eastern Sierra Nevada Mountains outside of the town of Mammoth Lakes, California. We offer an array of services including all-inclusive and customized pack trips, horseback vacations, seasonal horse drives, and the areas best daily horseback and mule trail rides.
